$comment: Campus lifecycle states as the sources define them (M2). Precedence decided 2026-09-15: HubSpot is the source of truth; see `precedence`. Counts and the jamaica-plain entry refreshed by hand from the growth map API and HubSpot on 2026-09-25 (no generator script exists in the playbook; generatedAt is the original 2026-09-15 capture). 2026-10-05 (MacKenzie Price, relayed and confirmed by Matt Barge; tests/fixtures/decisions/recorded/2026-10-05-campus-enrollment-state-48a1221b.json): an Open campus has a named enrollment state, enrolling or waitlist, and `type` stays Open for both. states.Open.enrollmentStates carries the two wordings; registry/campus-enrollment-state.json carries which campus is in which state and is the versioned membership list until a HubSpot Program property exists. The 12 alpha.school waitlist campuses' introStatement below was re-read from the live pages on 2026-10-05.

Open.source: HubSpot Programs property `type` as published by the growth map API (programType)
Open.meaning: Public campus page is a live destination; open-campus requirements apply.
Open.introSentence: by enrollment state (registry/campus-enrollment-state.json; check row campus.intro.status-source): enrolling -> '<name> is open and enrolling.'; waitlist -> the approved sentence in enrollmentStates.waitlist.statusSentence, verbatim. Decided by MacKenzie Price 2026-10-05, relayed and confirmed by Matt Barge (tests/fixtures/decisions/recorded/2026-10-05-campus-enrollment-state-48a1221b.json).

enrollmentStates.$comment: Named enrollment states of an Open campus. Not lifecycle types: `type` is Open for both, the open-campus requirements apply to both, and nothing about the page family changes. Membership and the full wording contract live in registry/campus-enrollment-state.json.
enrollmentStates.source: MacKenzie Price's 10:19 AM Slack instruction of 2026-10-05 naming the 13 campuses, Rachel Goodlad's admissions policy in the same thread, Yash Chitneni's four page elements; relayed and confirmed to the website agent by Matt Barge

Announced.meaning: Public page may exist; launch language allowed only when the source status and date support it; announced-campus requirements apply.
Announced.introSentence: dated (launch_date or opening_date set): named month or season and year supported by that date, e.g. '<name> is launching in Fall 2027.'; undated (no launch_date and no opening_date): '<name> is coming soon.' Decided by Matt Barge on 2026-09-28 (Slack conversation with the website agent; tests/fixtures/decisions/recorded/2026-09-28-check-rows-7db3cda2.json); check row campus.intro.status-source literals.undatedAnnounced.
Announced.bookACall: present: visible Book a Call on desktop, tablet and mobile linking to the campus's own HubSpot call_scheduling_link (Rachel Goodlad, Slack 2026-10-06, in answer to Matt Barge; check rows campus.resources.booking.present and campus.resources.booking.source-sync).

Pre-Announcement.meaning: No public campus page; map pin must route to a campus-specific Community destination.
Pre-Announcement.bookACall: absent: no campus page and no booking; Community routing (unchanged by the 2026-10-06 decision).
